title: Authored lines for the Unexpected Event table
label: invention
$comment: R32's table names each event in a few words and gives nine of the eleven rows no mechanical effect; reading I-30 supplies the mechanical floor and the engine carries it (packages/engine/src/combat/unexpected-event.ts). These are the lines the table reads when the row comes up. The row's printed text stays verbatim in unexpected-events.json. Rows 4 and 10 are the retreat rows, whose sealed Morale roll follows the line.

records.line: Something above takes an interest in you, and the interest is not friendly.
You are opened up, or the weapon leaves your hand, and either way the fight you were having is over.
They break off and go, and whether it was orders or nerve is not yours to know yet.
The room stops being the room: the floor, the light, or the sky decides otherwise.
The pause closes. You are back in it before you have finished the breath.
Footsteps behind them, more than one set, and they are not here for you.
Nothing has changed except your count of the exits. Fight on.
The ground gives, or the dark arrives, and both of you have to solve it before solving each other.
They withdraw, still facing you, and the withdrawal is a decision rather than a rout.
Their guard opens or their blade goes, and for a moment they are only a person standing there.
Something above takes an interest in you, and this time it is on your side.
